what: AnswerUpdated gaps of the Chainlink ETH/USD aggregators used as Ethereum-side canaries (owner-independent liveness feeds)
measured: 2026-11-08 ~19:40 UTC, last 7000 blocks (~23 h) per chain, updatedAt from the event data
method: proxy.aggregator() on the ETH/USD proxy (description() = "ETH / USD"), then cast logs AnswerUpdated(int256,uint256,uint256) in 500-block chunks
rule: default maxGap = max(measured max gap, 2 x measured median gap)
